messages:
sofia: quick heads-up — noticed a handoff hole in HS -> SF routing. when enrichment webhook stalls (>10s) the round-robin lambda retries and sometimes skips the proper owner, leaving lead unassigned.
ben: ugh, reproducible in staging?
sofia: yep, ran with 100 leads, ~3% got unassigned. logs show 429 + retry backoff timing out the claim step.
maya: can you paste the log snippet?
sofia: ```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z lead=LC-12345 status=queued enrichment=delayed webhook=timeout(504)
2026-03-18T14:02:21Z claim_attempt=1 owner=null result=retry_backoff
```
chris: looks like our claim flow assumes enrichment ack within 5s. Maybe increase heartbeat window or use optimistic claim with tombstone if enrichment completes later.
ben: proposal: 1) extend claim heartbeat to 12s for HS webhook path; 2) on retry, attempt to *re-enqueue* to the same owner for 60s before round-robin; 3) emit metric lead.claim.unassigned_count
lindsey: :thumbsup: for metrics. marketing needs SLA guarantees for demo accounts — what’s impact to SLA?
sofia: estimated unassigned rate drops <0.3% in canary. latency to first-touch increases by ~400ms in worst-case. still within our 2s SLA for 95th? need infra to confirm.
ops-bot: deploy-canary started by @ben for routing-service canary-2026-03-19
chris: also consider a soft-fallback rule in HubSpot: if owner null after 30s, route to overflow queue instead of full RR.
maya: I can update the HS workflow — will test with a 30s fallback. tagging @ben for the canary monitor.
ben: launching canary now. will post results in ~2h. if green, we’ll roll to prod and add playbook note for SDRs.
sofia: thanks team. ping me if you see orphaned leads in the dashboard, I'll triage.
